programs.title: The Jane Mysteries: A Deadly Prescription
programs.desc: Jane seeks justice for a teenager who's wrongfully imprisoned for murder. She and Detective John work together to prove the teen's innocence and help reunite him with his mother.

programs.title: The Jane Mysteries: Murder at Moseby
programs.desc: Jane goes undercover at her alma mater to help her college boyfriend solve a crime he may have witnessed years ago during the annual Edgar Allan Poe Festival.

programs.title: The Jane Mysteries: Too Much to Lose
programs.desc: When a reporter interviewing Jane seeks help to find a missing colleague, Jane takes on the case. Irene has disappeared after winning a game show which leads Jane to uncover a web of deceit.

programs.title: The Jane Mysteries: Inheritance Lost
programs.desc: Singer Jane Da Silva inherits a nonprofit detective agency that helps people who aren't able to help themselves. With guidance from her aunt and a detective, Jane takes on the case of a mother's untimely death years earlier.

programs.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries
programs.desc: When Aida Teagarden's real estate client is found murdered, her sleuthing daughter, Aurora, sets out with her fiancé, Nick, and the Real Murders Club to solve the murder.

programs.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Honeymoon Honeymurder
programs.desc: Aurora and Nick discover a body while on a pre-honeymoon getaway; as they get closer to finding out what really happened, danger knocks on their doorstep.
